[GSRS DM477EE40D](https://gsrs.ncats.nih.gov/api/v1/substances/DM477EE40D?view=full) links the maltose CAS and NCIt concept. These are source-supported candidates, not completed exact-identity rulings.

The completed current-byte assessments support both exact NCIt identities under MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 step 1. This is the sourced curation decision for Step 7d; no record has been edited yet and it grants no mapping-release or role approval.

- **Sodium carbonate monohydrate → NCIT:C80911, Sodium Carbonate Monohydrate.** The original CultureBotHT entry specifies Sigma S4132, CAS 5968-11-6 and mass 124. The inspected [NCIt concept](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C80911?include=full) has that CAS and the one-water formula; [PubChem CID 2735133](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/2735133) independently agrees with the form. The concept resolves locally, and an ignored-inclusive current-record search found no competing C80911 owner.
- **D-maltose monohydrate → NCIT:C80300, Maltose Monohydrate.** The original catalogue specifies Sigma M5885 and CAS 6363-53-7. The inspected [official M5885 specification](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/specification-sheets/677/787/M5885-BULK________SIAL_____.pdf) confirms that CAS, one water and mass 360.31. [NCIt](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C80300?include=full) and [GSRS DM477EE40D](https://gsrs.ncats.nih.gov/api/v1/substances/DM477EE40D?view=full) link the same registry identity, including its beta names, D-(+)-maltose monohydrate name and open-chain PubChem representation. Under §3's readable, orderable-identity rule, this supports the source-specific monohydrate concept. It does not infer a new anomer from a similar name or make the generic `Maltose_Hydrate` owner identical to this material.

Use `CAS_RN_LOOKUP` as the verified mapping method and `skos:exactMatch` to the new primary ontology identity. Preserve the preferred labels, verified chemistry, source context, counts, roles and all existing history. Preserve the two owners as separate records. The deferred `Maltose Hydrate` and `Sodium carbonate solution` owned-name pairs remain for the subsequent #669 step. The non-substance source fragment `(adjust if required)` on carbonate is a separate confirmed synonym finding to record before changing it.

Both current records pass native strict and term validation and equal their aggregate entries. Bounded installed and upstream ChEBI searches found no eligible exact hydrate term; this is a scoped search, not a universal absence claim. The old blanket absence narrative is superseded by this assessment, while its history remains preserved.
